source.name: Airwallex Newsroom: Airwallex Becomes the Giants' Official Jersey Patch Partner
source.quote: Airwallex will become the Giants' official jersey patch partner, debuting across Giants uniforms this season.
source.note: The club's own release is on mlb.com, which returns 403 to scripts and has no Wayback capture; the sponsor's own newsroom announcement was read instead. The patch is the only sponsor mark on an MLB uniform.
